d:
The third "season" of Suiton00's comics on his 'treon. The first comic has all of the base versions of the story pages organized sequentially. Then the variants of each page are shown in their own sequences. The textless version of img # 6 (img #46) is actually an edit I made, as the pack it came from seemingly mistakenly posted a duplicate of another page instead of the textless version. After all of the variants of the first comic are some lore pages of this comic. They were originally placed in between each variation sequence of the first comic's pages, but I reorganized them to be placed after them all. The comic pages that follow are otherwise unrelated to the plot of the first comic.
